title: Add CI tests that fail the build when the skills integrity gate regresses
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server, add a vitest suite for the new verification logic in src/setup/installSkills.ts covering three cases: (1) a tampered checksum aborts with a non-zero exit and nothing copied; (2) an unlisted file in the fetched set aborts; (3) a branch reference instead of the pinned commit in SKILLS_REPO aborts. The unit-tests CI gate (vitest, blocking) already fails the build; do not weaken the sast or secrets gates, and keep the test fixtures local so no test fetches from github.com.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm test in the mongodb-mcp-server checkout runs the new skills-integrity suite and all three cases pass
Reverting the pinned commit or removing the checksum gate makes at least one integrity test fail, so the blocking unit-tests CI gate fails
The integrity tests use local fixtures only; no test performs a network fetch

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer inspects the PR diff in applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server (src/setup/installSkills.ts plus the new test file), confirms the three tamper cases assert a non-zero exit and an untouched skills directory, then runs pnpm test and observes the integrity suite pass; corrupting one fixture checksum byte on a scratch branch makes the suite fail. Expected result: all three tamper cases pass on the fixed code and at least one fails on a reverted diff.

rootCause.description: No test or CI gate previously exercised the third-party skills install path, so unverified dependency consumption could regress without any build failure
